title: Unraveling the Intertwining Factors Underlying the Assembly of High-Nuclearity Heterometallic Clusters

synthesis.procedure: Co-hydrolysis of nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate and dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate with N-(2-hydroxyethyl)iminodiacetic acid and triethylamine under solvothermal conditions. Table 1 reports pure 1 after 72 h at 160 °C over the tested triethylamine range of 225–355 µL, or after 24 h at 170 °C over the tested range of 225–365 µL. The main article gives comparative reaction conditions rather than a complete isolation procedure.

reagents.name: Triethylamine
reagents.amount: 225–355 µL for the reported pure-1 runs at 160 °C for 72 h; 225–365 µL at 170 °C for 24 h

synthesis.temperature: 160 °C or 170 °C for the specified pure-1 runs
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Compound 1 crystallized from the reaction; isolation details are not given in the main article.

source_locations.location: Supplied cluster_complex catalog row for CCDC 2264206

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A comparatively compact, hollowed-out cubic cage with a 96-metal core dissected into seven concentric polyhedral shells, beginning with an Ni8 cubic shell and extending through Dy and Ni cube, icosahedron, and truncated-cube shells.

material_class.structural_family: Void-bearing, multishell dysprosium–nickel hydroxo cluster cage

synthesis.procedure: Co-hydrolysis of nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate and dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate with N-(2-hydroxyethyl)iminodiacetic acid and triethylamine under solvothermal conditions. Table 1 reports pure 2 after 24 h at 160 °C with 345–365 µL triethylamine; other combinations also give pure 2. The main article gives comparative reaction conditions rather than a complete isolation procedure.

reagents.name: Triethylamine
reagents.amount: 345–365 µL for the specified pure-2 runs at 160 °C for 24 h

synthesis.time: 24 h for the specified pure-2 runs
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Compound 2 crystallized from the reaction; isolation details are not given in the main article.

source_locations.location: Figure 1 caption and Table 1, including footnotes

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A larger-void-bearing, hollowed-out cubic cage with a 188-metal core dissected into twelve concentric polyhedral shells. The article describes distinct corner, edge, and inner-shell building units relative to compound 1.
